summary: Frontend-only verification for FixitZ admin+customer Flash Sale, Wallet, Referrals, signup referral capture, and admin order sound toggle. All 6 requested flows PASSED end-to-end on the 430x900 mobile viewport against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

test_results.admin_flash_sale: PASS — /admin/flash-sale renders. flash-timer-input & flash-timer-save present, saving timer works. In All Products, clicked Add (flash-toggle-<id>=Add), product moved to In Flash Sale, set flash-price-<id>=199, flash-price-save-<id> succeeded, then Remove restored original state.
test_results.customer_flash_sale: PASS — flash-see-all link present on home. /flash renders flash-sale-page with flash-countdown, 4 flash-product-<id> cards and 4 flash-add-<id> buttons. Clicking first flash-add incremented header cart badge from empty to 1.
test_results.admin_wallet: PASS — /admin/wallet renders with wallet-user-search. Searching 'test' filters list; clicked wallet-manage-<id>, wallet-dialog opened. Adding 200 showed toast '+₹200', txns list grew (5->). Deducting 50 added a debit txn (5->6). Balance visible in dialog header updated to ₹750.
test_results.admin_referrals: PASS — /admin/referrals shows summary cards Referrers=1, Referred Users=1, Rewards=₹100. One referral-row-<id> present, clicking expands referral-detail-<id>.
test_results.signup_referral_capture: PASS — /register shows reg-referral field labeled 'Referral code (optional)'. (Did not create new user to avoid data pollution; field wiring already backend-verified per E1 context.)
test_results.admin_orders_sound_toggle: PASS — admin-sound-toggle present on /admin/orders. Text toggles between 'Sound On' and 'Sound Off' on click.

critical_code_review_comments: AudioContext warning on /admin/orders is expected (browser requires user gesture); ensure sound only plays after admin interacts — current toggle-based approach is correct.
Console warning 'No routes matched location /logout' — consider adding a /logout route or hide any link that points there (minor).
Header cart badge selector: cart count is embedded inside header text; consider adding a dedicated data-testid="header-cart-count" for easier automated verification.
